Real pib.gov.in content from 2026-07-25, shared now as new. Official PIB release confirms NFDC has invited entries for the 57th International Film Festival of India to be held in Goa from November 20 to 28, 2026, and a second PIB release confirms the 57th edition returns in Panaji, Goa on those dates. Both event claims are accurate.
